Page 1 of 26
HISTORY
Motor vehicle accident on 04/23/2023, driver, sideswiped on the driver's side. First physical therapy evaluation in
this chart. Left shoulder symptoms are the focus of this sample rehabilitation plan.
SUBJECTIVE AND OBJECTIVE
Left shoulder pain with dressing and overhead reach. Pain 6/10. Active shoulder elevation 115 degrees and
abduction 95 degrees, limited by discomfort.
FUNCTIONAL ASSESSMENT
Difficulty with reaching and sustained upper-extremity activity. Patient is a right-hand-dominant financial advisor
and has been out of work since the accident.
PLAN
Establish a supervised rehabilitation program coordinated with orthopaedics. Review comfortable movement and
activity tolerance. Initial evaluation only; no separately billed treatment session on this page.
Clinician / record author: Michael Ludena, P.T.
